author: IGN
description:
Watch the final 'From the Ward' episode for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for a behind-the-scenes look at the making of the first-person shooter game and the process of creating live seasons. Join the development team at Infinity Ward as they discuss what's ahead with live seasons, and how stories, characters, Multiplayer, DMZ, and Call of Duty: Warzone come together in the journey ahead.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official 'From Launch to Live': From the Ward Ep. 8

author: IGN
description:
Get a deep dive into Phoenix Cyclops' moves in this latest trailer for the action fighting game, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls. Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC. Phoenix Cyclops will be available on November 2, and he is the first DLC character in Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, available as part of the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, included in the Digital Deluxe and Ultimate Editions. The Year 1 Character & Stage Pass and Phoenix Cyclops are also available for purchase separately.

An explosive all-rounder, Phoenix Cyclops controls the battlefield with devastating Optic Blasts, rushing attacks, and relentless close-range pressure. In this new character guide video for Phoenix Cyclops, learn how to generate Solar Shards and unleash his devastating Phoenix form, gaining incredible power at the cost of his own health.
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Phoenix Cyclops Character Guide Trailer

title: World of Warcraft: Forever | Planet Azeroth EP. 2 (ft. Bill Bailey)

author: IGN
description:
Take a look inside the Hail Mary in this latest trailer for Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, an upcoming mixed reality game that expands Andy Weir’s sci-fi universe. The new trailer showcases the ship's interior. A new adventure with Grace and Rocky awaits in Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, coming to PICO, Android XR, and Meta Quest 3 and Meta Quest 3S this fall 2026.

Step into the role of Ryland Grace in an original chapter of the Hail Mary mission, with James Ortiz reprising his role as Rocky. Experience humanity’s last hope firsthand as deep space grows increasingly uncertain around them. This mixed-reality experience blends your own physical environment with the Hail Mary itself. Diagnose problems, improvise solutions and push the limits of science and engineering to keep the mission alive.
title: Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars - Official Ship Reveal Trailer

author: IGN
description: Rip It! Card Collector is available now on Steam. Learn about your mission and get collecting in this Rip It! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and gathering all sets. Let's get cracking!
title: Rip It! Card Collector - Official Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out gameplay from the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Attack on Titan 3 in this new trailer for the upcoming action game. In Attack on Titan 3, you will dive into the action by taking on the role of a member of the Scout Regiment to relive the historical events that shaped the world alongside the iconic cast of Attack on Titan.

Attack on Titan 3 will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC via Steam, and Nintendo Switch 2 on December 10, 2026.
title: Attack on Titan 3 - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Gameplay Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take another look at Agni: Village of Calamity in this new trailer for the upcoming survival horror game set against the backdrop of Indonesian folklore. The new trailer showcases threats Agni will face and more. The trailer also features "Blood and Bones”, an original dark country and rock track created for the game by A. Crow and Black Razor Records. Agni: Village of Calamity will be available on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.

Agni, an investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality in Agni: Village of Calamity.
title: Agni: Village Of Calamity - Official Blood and Bones Trailer

author: IGN
description: Attack on Titan 3 may come with a number, but it isn’t a direct sequel in the truest sense of the word. It’s more of a retelling.  Based on my time with it, Attack on Titan 3 is juggling a lot of plates, and its ambition to do something new with the franchise is pretty laudable. Previewed by Will Borger
title: Attack on Titan 3: The Final Preview

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Some leaked info surrounding The Elder Scrolls 6 has popped up again, and The Verge is reporting that an official reveal could be around the corner, possibly November. A leaked, but unverified, title was floating around not too long ago, suggesting the official name for the game is The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, and The Verge is sticking by that name. The setting for the game is also heavily rumored to be Hammerfell. In other news, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma insists that Series X and S sales are being constrained by their availability...yeah sure. A quick glance at any major retailer's website shows the Xbox Series X and S and their many variants are in stock (except of course for some of the limited edition models). And finally, Phantom Blade Zero is a hit for Chinese game studio S-GAME. The game debuted to the number two spot on Steam's most-played list, with around 723,000 concurrents.
title: The Elder Scrolls 6 Reveal Could Be As Early As Next Month - IGN Daily Fix
